_readme: Maps abstract voice slots to real voices of one TTS provider.
The plan (audio/plan.json) only ever refers to slots, so changing provider
means editing this file and re-running the synthesis step — never re-planning.
Fill voiceMap from your provider's own voice list, e.g.:
Google: gcloud ml speech ... or GET /v1/voices?languageCode=de-DE
Pick clearly distinguishable voices — the point of separate slots is that a
learner can tell two speakers apart.
'speakers' overrides the automatic slot choice per test, per part, per person.
Use it when the planner reports that it cannot tell someone's gender, or when
you simply want a different voice for a character.
